notes: v514 — the 🔒 profit ladder on your trailing stops. Alongside the 🩤 trail, your winners now earn PERMANENT profit floors that step up in rungs and can never, ever move down. How it works: clear a rung plus your arm margin and the rung below is welded under the trade — with the defaults (5% rungs, 3% margin), clearing +8% locks +5%, clearing +13% locks +10%, +18% locks +15%, and so on forever. Set the margin to 2 for exactly 7→5, 13→10. The live stop is always the STRICTEST of your four protections — 🛑 hard stop, 🛡 break-even shield, 🩤 trail, 🔒 ladder — and all four only ever rise. Switch it on in 📐 My Rules next to the trailing stop (off by default; it runs wherever a trail runs — the 🤖 bot when its trail is on, your own shares only where you've added a 🩤). Holdings show their welded floor: '🔒 +10% profit locked'. Honesty unchanged: rungs arm on a CLOSE and take effect the next day, a hand-set 🔒 fixed stop still overrides everything, and a brutal overnight gap still fills at the open — a floor is an instruction, not a guarantee. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
